situation: Quantizing a vision backbone (VLM) for deployment.
decision: FP8 is reasonable where officially supported; avoid blindly quantizing the vision projector and vision encoder to 4-bit — OCR and grounding are more sensitive than conversational quality.
reasoning_physics: Vision encoder/projector outputs drive spatial grounding and OCR, which fail catastrophically at low precision where text quality degrades gracefully. The sensitive-links-in-a-chain rule: quantize the parts whose degradation is perceptual.
